title: Scaling a right triangle: 6-8-10
description:
See that doubling a 3-4-5 triangle gives 6² + 8² = 10² by counting unit squares.

• Start from the 3-4-5 right triangle and double every side to get 6, 8 and 10.
• Build a square on each side and count its unit squares: 36, 64 and 100.
• The two smaller squares together hold exactly as many unit squares as the largest one.

Result: 6² + 8² = 10² (36 + 64 = 100).
